inputs.text: [excited][playful] Here we are in the [serious] age of mammals! [happily] The sky clears up. The weather turns mild again. The forests grow back.
[playful] Warm and humid, [happily] like a giant greenhouse. [softly] Mammals, once hiding under the dinosaurs' feet, can finally grow.
[excited][quickly] Huge! [amazed] Smilodon, the saber-tooth cat! [happily] A giant sloth, big as an elephant. [gasps] Titanoboa, a snake forty feet long!
[gasps][excited] As long as a house! [playful] And some mammals go back to living in the water: whales and dolphins. [softly] Their babies drink milk… [pauses] underwater.
[excited] Time goes on. [playful] Then, [pauses] the cold comes back. [serious] Really cold…
